title: Kappa Factor Hom Triviality
body_html:
Kappa Factor Hom Triviality

For each positive-depth Yu layer in the one-block calculation, the \(\Delta^j\)-image is maximal isotropic in the corresponding finite symplectic quotient, and \[ \operatorname{Hom}_{Q_j} (\omega_{\Gamma_{j-1},M}\otimes(1\otimes\chi_{\Gamma_j,M}),\chi_M) \simeq \chi_M \] as a module for the preceding layer \(P^{j-1}\). Hence \[ \dim\operatorname{Hom}_{P^j}(\kappa_M^j,\chi_M)=1 \] for all \(j\).
proof_html: The image of \(Q_j\) in the finite Heisenberg quotient is the maximal isotropic subspace supplied by supercuspidal_theta.maximal_isotropic_delta_subspace. The mixed model for the finite Heisenberg-Weil representation gives a one-dimensional Hom space against the corresponding character. The \(\Delta^0\)-action contributes the determinant character of the isotropic subspace, but that determinant is trivial by supercuspidal_theta.triviality_of_bc_character. The lower layer \(Q_{j-1}\) acts through \(\chi_M\). Induction on \(j\), starting from the depth-zero character, gives the one-dimensional statement for \(\kappa_M^j\).
